class.name: dobot_kinematics_plugin/DobotKinematicsPlugin
class.description: MoveIt2 kinematics plugin that delegates FK/IK to the Dobot controller's real-DH ROS services (/dobot_bringup_ros2/srv/PositiveKin and /dobot_bringup_ros2/srv/InverseKin). Falls back to the KDL plugin (theoretical DH) when the controller is unreachable. Units / orientation convention are configurable via kinematics.yaml.
